title: Global Group Fairness in Federated Learning via Function Tracking
reasoning: The paper focuses on the mathematical and algorithmic aspects of group fairness (statistical parity) in a federated learning setting. It uses standard fairness metrics like Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) to ensure demographic parity across groups (e.g., race, gender). While fairness is an ethical desideratum in AI, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, moral reasoning, or specific ethical frameworks, treating the problem instead as a statistical distribution-matching task.
